OPEN SOURCE · 31 OCT 2026
This open model makes videos by writing code
SenseNova 6.8 Code2Video from SenseTime. Free weights on Hugging Face.
27B parameters, built on Qwen3.8-27B · Free, Apache 2.0 license · 10h+ long runs, 2,000+ turns
WHY IT MATTERS
- It writes code, renders the video, checks the frames, then fixes its own work
- Want a change? Give notes and it revises the same project
- Code can call image, video and 3D models in one pipeline
- It made its own 90-second launch film, with sound
HOW IT WORKS
1. Expand your idea into a detailed prompt → 2. Code2Video builds the video → 3. You give notes, it revises.
Source: Hugging Face / SenseNova
